description: A source row measured in one unit may match a consensus flow declared in another. Where the two are related by a constant -- Bq and kBq, m3 and sm3 -- the value has to be multiplied or the number published is wrong by that factor. The run flags these rows and converts none of them. See #78.

expectations.title: No source row lands on a flow measured in a different unit without being converted
expectations.comment: 170 BAFU rows in the 2026-08-14 build. 103 measured in Bq match a kBq flow and 47 go the other way -- a factor of a thousand each -- 14 radionuclide rows match a kg flow, one m3 row matches sm3 and one kWh row matches MJ. Two ecoinvent 3.8 rows are flagged as well; they have their own expectation below so that fixing one list does not read as fixing both.

expectations.title: The same holds for ecoinvent 3.8
expectations.comment: 2 rows: Manganese-55 in groundwater, matching a kg flow while measured in kBq. Met on the build of 1 September 2026, and the pending flag was dropped with that recording.
